name: drift
title: When the Server Changes a Form
kicker: The pin catches it, the run stops clean, a walk repairs it
html:
When the Server Changes a Form

  1. scm:pulls-get✓
  2. watcher:watch✓
  3. scm:merge✕✓
  4. ci:build✓
  5. hr:in-reply-to✓
  6. ci:smoke-test✓
  7. env:promote✓
The forge changed scm:merge illustrated 
  schema:
    required:
      - method
+     - sha
    properties:
+     sha: { type: string }
Held to its pin 
pinned   sha256-sGUdrPfHMytyy3aRS+Ep6H4votEj67pw…
offered  a different hash   ≠
stopped at step 3 by its guardscm:merge changed since the lock file. 501 still open.
Claude walks it again 
PUT /repos/acme/web/pulls/501/actions/merge
{ "method": "squash", "sha": "dafbbfee1f2a…" }   ← 501's head.sha
Kept again, new pinReplays: 0 model calls.
say: What if the server changes under a kept script? Here's an illustrated change: the forge makes sha required on scm:merge. The replay runs: pull request opened, watch asked. At the merge, before acting, ARTIE hashes the form it's offered and holds it to the pin. It differs. The guard stops the run at step three. Nothing half-done: 501 is still open, nothing built, nothing promoted. Then the repair: walk the goal again with Claude. Claude reads the new form and fills sha from the pull request's own head. The generator keeps the script again, with a new pin, and every replay after that asks no model. AI at the edge, only where something changed.
